chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Aban, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who performs salat (prayer), then sits and breaks wudu (ablution) before giving taslim. He said: His salat (prayer) is complete.

key_terms.فَيُحْدِثُ: enters a state of hadath, breaking wudu (ablution)
key_terms.يَجْلِسُ: sits after completing the main acts of prayer
key_terms.يُسَلِّمَ: to give the taslim ending formula of the prayer

ai.seo_question: If someone breaks wudu before taslim, is the salat still valid?
ai.summary: This hadith states that if a person completes the salat (prayer) and then breaks wudu (ablution) before saying the taslim, the prayer is still considered complete. It is cited in the context of the ruling that taslim is not obligatory as an essential pillar for the validity of the prayer.
